def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    remaining = bins[mask] - item
    relative_waste = remaining / (bins[mask] + 1e-8)
    scores[mask] = 1.0 / (relative_waste + 1e-8)
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    mask = remaining >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_bins = bins[mask]
    remaining_valid = remaining[mask]

    # Normalize remaining capacity to [0, 1] range relative to bin size
    normalized_remaining = remaining_valid / (valid_bins + 1e-10)

    # Sigmoid function centered around 0.5 (moderate utilization)
    deviation_from_optimal = np.abs(normalized_remaining - 0.5)
    sigmoid_score = 1 / (1 + np.exp(4 * (deviation_from_optimal - 0.5)))

    # Scale to emphasize moderate utilization
    scores[mask] = sigmoid_score * (1 + item / (valid_bins + 1e-10))

    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    remaining = bins - item
    remaining = np.clip(remaining, 0, None)
    mask = remaining >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_bins = bins[mask]
    remaining_valid = remaining[mask]
    
    # Avoid division by zero and handle edge cases
    ratio = item / (remaining_valid + 1e-10)
    
    # Logarithmic penalty for very low or very high remaining capacity
    log_penalty = np.log(remaining_valid + 1e-5) + np.log(valid_bins - remaining_valid + 1e-5)
    
    # Combine ratio and penalty: higher score when item fills a large fraction and utilization is moderate
    combined_score = ratio * (1 - 0.5 * np.abs(log_penalty - np.mean(log_penalty)))
    
    scores[mask] = combined_score
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    prio = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    mask = bins >= item
    if not mask.any():
        return prio
    remaining = bins[mask] - item
    utilization = (bins[mask] - remaining) / bins[mask]
    # Apply logarithmic scaling based on utilization
    log_util = np.log1p(utilization)  # log(1 + utilization)
    ideal_remainder = item * (0.5 + 0.3 * log_util)
    prio[mask] = -np.abs(remaining - ideal_remainder)
    return prio

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    prio = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    mask = bins >= item
    remaining = bins[mask] - item
    # Ideal residual capacity for future pairing: exactly one more item can fit
    ideal_residual = item
    # Measure deviation from ideal residual capacity for pairing
    deviation = np.abs(remaining - ideal_residual)
    # Use inverse deviation as priority, penalizing large deviations
    prio[mask] = -deviation
    return prio
